He dialed in the midrange to be more nuanced. You still get that classic midrange bump but without some of the inherent nasaliness that can sometimes plague this circuit. He altered the clipping to be slightly less symmetrical. He also tweaked the low end to give it more fullness while still maintaining a tight and punchy low end. Why Gritador? Because it means “screamer” in Portuguese. This is Dave's favorite version of his favorite overdrive. Q - WHAT IS THE BLEM MODEL? A blem model is a slightly blemished model that did not pass our rigorous visual paint inspection. It could be a scratch, a paint inclusion, or some other finish issue. The pedal is 100% mechanically working, it’s just a case finish issue and because it is, you win! FOR INTERNATIONAL ORDERS - Please see our international dealers.
